From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Recap & next steps from demo — vendor intake & PO path

Thanks for taking the time earlier, Angela — appreciated the candid discussion. Quick written recap and a set of concrete next steps so we stay aligned with your procurement cadence.

Call recap (high level):
- Use case: inference for clinical document summarization (pilot scope: 3 teams, ~20 users).
- Decision criteria mentioned: data locality (US), SOC2 evidence, predictable per-token cost, and ability to pin model versions for audits.
- Stakeholders you called out: Lisa Chen (economic buyer / VP Product), Tom Leary (legal/security), and procurement@northbridgehealth.com for PO & invoicing.

Open questions / asks from our side:
1) Please confirm the procurement contact we should send the onboarding packet to (procurement@... ok?).
2) Does NorthBridge require a PO for pilot contracts, and if so, typical lead time for PO approval?
3) Preferred invoicing/payment terms (Net30/Net45) and remit address for invoices.
4) Any additional security artifacts beyond SOC2 Type II that we should include (e.g., penetration test report, CIS benchmark)?

Attachments: SOW draft (high level scope) and vendor questionnaire (initial).

Proposed next steps:
- We will fill the vendor questionnaire and return it by EOD tomorrow (Feb 11).
- Marcus will prepare a short technical onboarding plan and a one-page runbook for your security team.
- If procurement can share the vendor intake link + PO timeline, we’ll align dates and push a draft SOW to legal.

Would you be able to confirm whether procurement@northbridgehealth.com is the right intake address and an estimated PO window (e.g., 2–4 weeks)?

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from demo — vendor intake & PO path

Thanks, Evelyn — good summary. Quick answers:
- Procurement intake: yes, procurement@northbridgehealth.com is the correct intake address (cc'd).
- PO requirement: We do require a PO for any vendor engagement. Typical internal approval for pilots is ~3 weeks but can vary by spend level.
- Payment terms: Standard is Net45, but for pilots we sometimes do Net30 if legal signs off.
- Security: SOC2 Type II is required. We also ask for an answer to our vendor risk questionnaire; if you can fill that we’ll route to Tom for legal review. If available, please include pen-test summary or where we can access more details.

I’ll introduce Lisa separately to help prioritize the pilot. For now, please send the completed questionnaire to procurement@northbridgehealth.com and Tom will confirm any redlines for the SOW.

Angela
Director, Partnerships
NorthBridge Health

From: NorthBridge Health Procurement <procurement@northbridgehealth.com>

Cc: Tom Leary <tleary@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding steps and required docs — Redwood Inference

Hi Evelyn — welcome. Procurement here with the onboarding checklist and timeline so you have everything in one place.

Required items for vendor setup:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (link below) — includes W-9, remit address, primary contact, and bank details for ACH.
- Signed W-9 (US vendors).
- Copy of SOC2 Type II report or SOC2 letter of attestation (if available).
- Completed vendor risk questionnaire (we received Angela's note).
- SOW or Statement of Work to route to Legal (Tom cc'd).

Onboarding process and timing:
1) You submit the onboarding form + W-9 + questionnaire.
2) Procurement validates banking and tax docs (3–5 business days).
3) Legal reviews SOW (typically 5–10 business days depending on redlines).
4) PO issuance after approvals (we aim for 10 business days after legal sign-off for standard pilots).

Typical PO lead time for a small pilot is ~3 weeks from submission but can extend to 6 weeks if there are substantive legal redlines or additional security review requirements. If you need a faster turnaround, flag the deal as a pilot and provide cost/term thresholds for expedited routing.

Please use this intake link to submit documents: https://northbridgehealth.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/vendor-intake-form
DocuSign link for vendor packet: https://docusign.com/nbh/vendor/packet/ABC123

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable), vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Best,
NorthBridge Procurement Team
procurement@northbridgehealth.com

- Would NorthBridge consider Net30 for the initial 90-day pilot? If legal or procurement needs it, we can accept Net45 but Net30 would help our pilot cashflow.

If procurement can confirm an estimated PO date (given submission today), that helps — we’re hoping for PO before 2027-03-03 to align onboarding with your teams.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Evelyn Hart
